messages:
Neha Rao: Quick sync — new merchant emailed asking for guidance on AWS/GCP/Azure listing requirements (tax IDs, marketplace visibility, and branding). Can legal + ops triage?
Tim (Legal): Thanks Neha. Can you drop the merchant's country and entity type? tax rules differ for non-US publishers.
Neha Rao: They're US-registered (LLC) but want EU pricing. Also flagged that the AWS PR requires logo in SVG + 1:1 PNG. Link to their asset pack: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/inbound/merchant-438-assets
Samir Patel: Noted. For trial sku mapping: we should confirm whether trial is handled by marketplace or in-app. If marketplace trial, need SKU + entitlement mapping for each cloud.
Clare - Partnerships: I'll ask the merchant to fill the marketplace onboarding template. Samir - can you paste the SKU/entitlement example we use?
Samir Patel: Sure — example snippet: `SKU: RDW-CORE-TRIAL | Entitlement: trial-7d | BillingModel: trial` . We'll need one per cloud, and region visibility flags.
Tim (Legal): For EU pricing, merchant needs VAT registration or we charge gross. I can draft the clause for the listing terms. Also confirm they accept our standard EULA localization.
Brian Ops: FYI — for GCP we need a project ID and a verified domain for the listing. For AWS, we need AMI IDs and region whitelist. I can run an asset check once they upload AMI/VM metadata.
MarketplaceBot: asset-checker started for merchant-438 — missing: SVG logo, EU tax doc, AMI manifest. See https://redwood.internal/marketplace/checks/438
Neha Rao: Action items: 1) Clare to collect onboarding template from merchant 2) Samir to prepare SKU mapping 3) Tim to draft VAT/EULA clause 4) Brian to validate AMI/region manifest. Target: end of week.
Clare - Partnerships: I'll ping them now and set a deadline (Thu EOD). Adding a quick checklist in the doc.
Tim (Legal): I'll post the clause in this thread when ready. If they want custom terms, escalate and cc legal-esc.
Samir Patel: I'll create the three sample SKUs and share in #partnerships by tomorrow morning.
Brian Ops: Once they upload AMI/VM manifests I'll run the asset-checker and post results here.
Neha Rao: Thanks team :raised_hands: — keeping this thread as the single source. Tag me if merchant pushes a signed contract or asks for faster onboarding.
MarketplaceBot: reminder: marketplace onboarding templates are here https://redwood.internal/marketplace/templates — fill `onboard_v2.csv`
Neha Rao: Closing loop — Clare, when you have their template, ping Tim & Samir for final signoff before we submit to cloud marketplaces.
Clare - Partnerships: Will do.
